notes: New world-best constraints on dark photon kinetic mixing from INTEGRAL/SPI 16-year dataset using dark photon trident decay (A' → 3γ) in the mass range 61–1022 keV. Constraints derived from diffuse x-ray background analysis with improved astrophysical background modeling and full one-loop decay amplitude (not just Euler-Heisenberg approximation). Assumes dark photon comprises all dark matter with NFW profile (ρ☉ = 0.42 GeV/cm³, rs = 9.98 kpc). Data points extracted from Figure 4 (blue line) showing kinetic mixing ε vs dark photon mass m_A'. The paper improves previous constraints by ~1-2 orders of magnitude through better background subtraction and theoretical treatment. Confidence level is 95% C.L. as stated in abstract and figures. | selector: text (sole candidate)
